newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Dec 8.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Dec 8.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina has directed the food ministry to go for efficient management of foodgrains with well-coordinated measures.

Agricultural growth rate is falling sharply in the country due to declining soil fertility, inefficiency in use of fertiliser, increasing intensity of pest attack and some other reasons, experts told a seminar.

Former finance minister and BNP leader Saifur Rahman said the current crisis in the stock market may cause severe socio-economic hardship and political implications. He blamed the crisis on mismanagement of the bourses.
BNP secretary-general Abdul Mannan Bhuiyan has demanded that the government must disclose the contents of the (proposed) water sharing agreement with India.
An Independence Monument will be erected at the city's Suhrawardy Uddyan to commemorate the historic speech by the Father of Nation Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujibur Rahman.
One self-styled lieutenant of another sepoy of the rebel Shanti Bahini in Chittagong Hill Tracts have surrendered to security forces with arms and ammunition on Saturday.
The demand for bitumen, one of the main raw materials for development work, such as construction of roads and highways, has decreased alarmingly during the current season.
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina said her government had taken all possible steps to increase foodgrain production so the country no more has to face food deficit.
